description: One record per IIC annual report document. An institution may appear more than once (different years, or two records for the same PDF when its narrative and KPI form disagree - see `contradiction_of`).

fields.year: Reporting year or academic year of the document.
fields.iic_id: IIC portal identifier where the institution published it. Often absent.
fields.star_rating: ARIIA/IIC star band, self-reported by the institution.
fields.evidence_tier: Repository standard (00_Research_Index/README.md s3). IIC annual reports are T1 - an institution's own report about itself is a primary source. See CORPUS_TIER_MAP for the full corpus mapping.
fields.parse_status: One of: access_denied, header_only, not_found, parsed, partial, unparseable.
fields.metrics: Only values actually read from the document. Absent key = not read, NOT zero.
fields.metrics_note: Interpretation guard. Read this before quoting any figure.
fields.contradiction_of: Set when this record captures a value that conflicts with another record.
fields.pending_extraction: What still has to be read from this document.
fields.quote_candidates: Verbatim strings usable as evidence quotes, with their source context.

metric_semantics.amount_inr: Rupees spent on promotion/awareness of innovation & entrepreneurship on campus. Field name in source: 'Amount spent on promotion and awareness generation'.
metric_semantics.grant_total_inr: Rupees of grant or fund support reaching student/faculty-led innovation, startups and IPR. NOTE: observed to absorb unrelated large government research grants.
metric_semantics.activities_total: Count of I&E and IPR activities. May be stated in narrative, KPI form, or both, and may disagree.
metric_semantics.ips_total: Combined generated/published/granted IP count as the institution summarises it. Institutions frequently mix current-year and cumulative in this field.

known_defects: amount_inr and grant_total_inr are reported by 22 of 36 documents; the rest use prose or ranges.
'ideas generated' is not a consistent measurement - see iic_corpus_analysis.md section 3.
Six same-document contradictions are catalogued in iic_contradictions.csv.
